data_fields.name: flee_health
data_fields.donor_constant: per species arm, e.g. Human 0.4, Pig 0.5, Boar 0.1 (floor 0.25 in the score)

data_fields.name: aggro_dist
data_fields.donor_constant: Humanoid Some(20.0); other bodies None (always aggressive)

data_fields.name: sight_dist
data_fields.donor_constant: per species arm (not read for each arm); used as fallback when aggro_dist is None

data_fields.name: should_stop_pursuing
data_fields.donor_constant: true by default; false for BloodmoonBat and BirdLarge

best_idea: Decide break-off with a two-score race (keep-chase score from aggression over distance and target health, versus let-go score from anchor distance, time since last hit and own health) instead of a fixed leash radius.
decision_why: The race gives one formula whose inputs are row fields (flee_health, aggro radius, boolean never-breaks-off), so new creatures are rows; adapt because the donor's clock runs from target selection (a defect) and its divisions have no floor, both fixed in the sketch; GPL-3.0 means clean-room only.
acceptance: Server test: an NPC hit by its target within the last 2 s keeps chasing at 30 m from its anchor; an NPC not hit for 60 s and 60+ m from its anchor drops the target and walks home; a 0-health or 0-distance input returns a finite result and never throws.
